Icescopy.summary: Application startup, main window, and coordination of session state and tools.
Icescopy.details: The `IceScopy` window connects frame sources, cell records, graphics, result tables, history, and import/export actions. Many public-looking methods depend on initialized widgets and window state; they are not independent batch APIs. See [Architecture Overview](Architecture-Overview.md) before changing a workflow.

IcescopyApplication.summary: Handles operating-system file-open events and defers session opening until the main window is available.

IceScopy.summary: Owns the active desktop session and coordinates helper modules.
IceScopy.details: Prefer focused helper modules for numerical work and parsing. Use the existing capture/restore and command methods for undoable changes; direct mutation can leave records, results, selection, and graphics inconsistent. Cells-list navigation optionally opens the event chosen by `FreezeEventSelector`, then centers circle bounds at the displayed frame without changing zoom. Completed list selections, repeated clicks on Cell rows, and user activation of either checkbox apply all enabled options. Explicit Cells event selection works independently of Show freeze frame and honors Auto-center. Timeline event arrows instead choose the nearest earlier or later event relative to the current frame across selected cells, or all cells when none are selected; they preserve the camera and remembered cycle without applying Auto-center. Cursor and permanent Pan mode are supported; unfinished drawing or editing and temporary Space panning block navigation. Image selections and selection refresh signals do not trigger navigation. The Cursor Tool Options button provides manual centering for cells selected in the image or list. Redraws, history restoration, and interaction changes cancel pending navigation so an interrupted gesture cannot move the view later.

icescopy_analysis_windows.summary: Convert start/end markers into inclusive frame ranges.
icescopy_analysis_windows.details: Indexes are zero-based. With no markers, analysis covers the source. A leading end uses the first frame, a trailing start uses the last, consecutive starts keep the latest, and extra ends after a closed range are ignored. These ranges control both frame measurement and separate freeze searches.

icescopy_aux.summary: Viewer input handling, analysis worker, and preference dialogs.
icescopy_aux.details: `Image_analysis_thread` measures circular regions and runs freeze detection. It emits progress and retains completed results for the window to install after the thread finishes. `PreferencesDialog` also edits the default sample-field schema. These responsibilities share a file for historical reasons.

ColorPreferenceButton.summary: Edits a color preference through a native color picker.

CustomGraphicsView.summary: Routes scene mouse, wheel, and keyboard events to the active drawing, selection, or image-edit workflow.
CustomGraphicsView.details: This is the current-frame view. It inherits synchronized pan and zoom support from `LinkedGraphicsView`; neighboring panes use `ReferenceGraphicsView` so their mouse events cannot modify current-frame cells.

Image_analysis_thread.summary: Measures per-frame circular regions and builds grayscale and freeze-event tables in a Qt worker thread.
Image_analysis_thread.details: The `analysis_done` signal reports frame progress, not completion of the whole run. Qt’s `finished` signal triggers result installation. Exceptions are retained in `analysis_error` and `analysis_traceback`; normal in-app analysis passes no output filename and keeps results in memory. Frames outside selected ranges remain `nan` rows in the grayscale table.

PreferencesDialog.summary: Edits application preferences and the default sample metadata schema.
PreferencesDialog.details: Sample-field changes have their own validation and dropped-value confirmation. Preference persistence and applying settings to the live window are separate operations; see the preference tests before changing their order.

SortImagesDialog.summary: Presents supported frame or video-clip ordering choices and returns the selected sort mode.

icescopy_cell.summary: Cell identity, sample assignment, and analysis-record synchronization.
icescopy_cell.details: `CellRecord` contains identity and results, not geometry. Geometry lives in current and keyframe cell snapshots. `CellStateManager` updates the window-owned registry and related table labels. Read [Cell System](Cell-System.md) for the invariants.

CellRecord.summary: Serializable per-cell identity, sample assignment, grayscale measurements, and freeze events.
CellRecord.details: A cell ID joins geometry and result columns. Explicit renaming is supported through `CellStateManager`; do not rewrite only this field. Missing grayscale measurements may be represented by floating-point NaN.

CellStateManager.summary: Keeps cell IDs, saved records, keyframes, and result-table labels consistent.
CellStateManager.details: Allocation uses the lowest available non-negative ID after considering current geometry, keyframes, and records. Renaming rejects collisions and updates dependent headers and freeze labels.

icescopy_cell_controller.summary: Cell drawing and editing, pinned previews, and scene synchronization.
icescopy_cell_controller.details: The controller works with the main window’s geometry and graphics scene. Single-cell and grid previews are transient until Apply commits them. Selection identifies cells by ID; rendering can replace scene items. See [Cell System](Cell-System.md).

PreviewAnchorHandle.summary: A movable scene handle that repositions a pinned cell or grid preview.

CellEditController.summary: Coordinates selection, single/group edits, preview placement, and committed cell geometry.
CellEditController.details: Preview state includes whether the layout is floating or pinned. Applying a preview uses the window’s history support; avoid treating the preview graphics as saved cells.

icescopy_cell_items.summary: Geometry snapshots and interactive graphics items for cell circles.
icescopy_cell_items.details: `CellSnapshot` is lightweight geometry/state that can be copied without owning a Qt scene object. `CellCircle` paints and handles interaction in the scene. Neither replaces `CellRecord` for sample assignment or analysis values.

CellSnapshot.summary: A compact geometry snapshot used by history, interpolation, and analysis.
CellSnapshot.details: `circle_positions` is the scene center; `circle_pixel_positions` is the center in original-image coordinates; `circle_sizes` is the radius. The ID connects this geometry to its cell record.

CellCircle.summary: Draws a cell outline and ID, with selection, hover, and edit feedback.
CellCircle.details: Rendered items can be synchronized or rebuilt while navigating. `read_only=True` draws neighboring-frame circles without mouse, hover, or selection interactions; painting these copies only reads existing cell records. Keep long-lived analysis data in `CellRecord` and use IDs when restoring selections.

icescopy_dialogs.summary: Input dialogs for session metadata, temperature import, and export selection.
icescopy_dialogs.details: Dialogs gather and validate user choices; parsing and count calculations belong to the temperature and freeze-count modules. `get_values()` results are consumed by the matching main-window import action.

NewSessionMetadataDialog.summary: Collects project, user, institution, and date metadata for a session.

CSUTemperatureImportDialog.summary: Collects a CSU Ice Spectrometer input file and import options.

UTKTemperatureImportDialog.summary: Collects UTK temperature data and video timing options.

TAMUTemperatureImportDialog.summary: Collects TAMU Linkam temperature and optional calibration inputs.

PKUTemperatureImportDialog.summary: Collects a Linksys32 IML file and PKU import options.

StandardTemperatureImportDialog.summary: Collects standard CSV import choices and previews image timestamp parsing.

OutputResultsDialog.summary: Lets the user choose among the result exports currently available.

icescopy_dock.summary: Custom title bar for movable and floating dock panels.
icescopy_dock.details: This is presentation code for Qt dock widgets. Keep scientific and session state in their owning modules rather than adding it to title-bar events.

DockTitleBar.summary: Provides dock title-bar controls and drag behavior.

icescopy_frame_source.summary: A shared frame interface for images, video, and ordered video clips.
icescopy_frame_source.details: Display, analysis, and navigation ask a `FrameSource` for frame names, keys, pixels, and timing. Video uses PyAV and can retain a decoder plus a temporary PNG preview cache. Source payloads reference original media; session files do not embed it. A video sequence maps a global frame index to a clip and local index.

VideoFrameMetadata.summary: A video frame’s index, presentation timestamp, and time in seconds.
VideoFrameMetadata.details: `pts` is a presentation timestamp in stream units, and `time_seconds` is relative playback time. These values may be inferred from container duration/rate or read from decoded frames. They are not wall-clock dates, and the fast metadata path does not establish exact variable-frame-rate timing.

FrameSource.summary: The common interface consumed by frame display, navigation, and grayscale analysis.
FrameSource.details: Ranges passed to `iter_gray_arrays` are inclusive. `frame_key` identifies a frame for caches and per-frame edits; a displayed basename is not a unique substitute. Base methods can raise `NotImplementedError`; there is no formal abstract-base-class enforcement.

ImageSequenceFrameSource.summary: Reads individual image files and exposes their order as frames.
ImageSequenceFrameSource.details: Image-file operations are supported here. Grayscale analysis reads through OpenCV; display uses QImage.

VideoFrameSource.summary: Decodes a single video, exposes frame metadata, and manages video preview caching.
VideoFrameSource.details: The grayscale modes are converted grayscale and the video luma plane (brightness data directly from a supported decoded format). They are different measurement choices. Call `close()` to release decoder resources and an owned temporary cache; do not rely on finalization for deterministic cleanup. Metadata may be inferred from regular spacing before a full decode fallback; check timing-sensitive changes against variable-frame-rate files.

VideoSequenceFrameSource.summary: Presents several ordered video clips as one frame sequence.
VideoSequenceFrameSource.details: Global indexes change if clips are reordered. `frame_reference` and `global_index_for_reference` provide the clip/local-index mapping; preserve this mapping when remapping markers and results.

icescopy_frameslider.summary: Timeline navigation, zoom, and marker drawing.
icescopy_frameslider.details: The slider distinguishes keyframes, freeze annotations, and analysis start/end markers. Platform-specific hit testing and painting share the same logical frame indexes. A freeze flag reflects selected-cell events, or all cells when none are selected; it is not a general bookmark.

FrameSlider.summary: Paints frame positions and markers and sends timeline navigation actions to the main window.

SliderZoom_Slider.summary: A slider used to adjust timeline zoom.

icescopy_event_navigation.summary: Provide shared freeze-event buttons and a Cells selector that retains the chosen cooling cycle.
icescopy_event_navigation.details: `FreezeEventButton` gives the Cells selector and timeline matching arrow-and-dot icons and button styling. The selector below the Cells checkboxes provides previous/next arrows and a dropdown. Its explicit actions navigate even when Show freeze frame is off, and Auto-center independently controls centering at the destination. Controls refresh without navigating. Known cooling cycles come from imported frame assignments; unknown cycles use event-order labels without inferring cycle identity. Timeline event targets and camera-preserving navigation are coordinated by the main window.

FreezeEventButton.summary: Render the existing timeline arrowhead with a freeze-event dot in a shared button style.
FreezeEventButton.details: Used by both the Cells selector and the timeline. `update_appearance()` receives the existing directional arrow icon and active theme, adds the red event dot, and supplies a gray disabled version. It retains the timeline's button geometry and interaction styling while keeping a fixed compact width. Set `timeline=False` for a selector beside a native combo box; this removes the timeline's top margin so their visible centers align. The button owns appearance only; its caller supplies event-navigation behavior.

FreezeEventComboBox.summary: Captures the selection context when an event dropdown or keyboard action begins.
FreezeEventComboBox.details: Internal `QComboBox` subclass owned by `FreezeEventSelector`. It refreshes available events before interaction and retains the context used to reject an activation after the cell, frame source, event records, or cycle assignments change.

FreezeEventSelector.summary: Tracks the chosen freeze event and cooling cycle and performs explicit event navigation.
FreezeEventSelector.details: `refresh()` reads the current single-cell selection, valid event frames, and imported cycle assignments without changing the displayed frame. A chosen cycle persists across cells; a missing event in that cycle leaves no navigation target while other events remain accessible. The exact chosen event is retained for the same cell after manual browsing. Cycle IDs are zero-based internally and displayed from one; unknown cycles use one-based event ordinals. Arrows stop at the ends. Button and dropdown actions compare captured context with current state before navigating, and navigation respects the main window's editing guards. Source or cycle-assignment changes reset the remembered choice.

icescopy_freeze_count_timeseries.summary: Build sample-group freeze counts matched to temperature records.
icescopy_freeze_count_timeseries.details: The mixin joins the window’s cell events and sample catalog with parsed temperature data. Import-specific builders share grouping, cycle, and temperature-calibration helpers. Counts are exported without blank correction, including each blank sample as an ordinary output group. Group identity is the sample ID, not the editable sample name. These builders are coupled to window state; the parsing module contains the independent file parsers.

FreezeCountTimeseriesMixin.summary: Adds temperature/count result construction methods to the main window.
FreezeCountTimeseriesMixin.details: The class is used as a mixin: its methods run on `IceScopy` and expect its records, preferences, and frame helpers. Import builders also retain their actual frame-to-cycle assignments for event review when a reset temperature is configured. `freeze_review_cycle_ids()` returns verified zero-based assignments in frame order, separately from counts. These assignments can survive event corrections; reimport temperature data when recomputed counts are needed.

icescopy_freeze_cycles.summary: Preserve and validate imported cooling-cycle assignments for freeze-event review.
icescopy_freeze_cycles.details: Cycle metadata stores ordered frame identities, zero-based cycle IDs or unknown values, and the configured reset temperature. It records the temperature importer's assignments rather than redetecting cycles from event order. Frame identities must match the current source exactly before assignments are returned. Metadata is separate from frozen counts and annotations so event corrections need not remove known cycle labels. Legacy recovery accepts only explicit cycle columns with a configured reset threshold and unambiguous frame matching; uncertain assignments remain unknown.

icescopy_freezfinder.details: Detection filters a grayscale series, searches peaks with the configured width/prominence, and refines event positions against the raw signal. Finite runs are processed separately so missing values do not bridge unmeasured gaps. The main application uses these functions through the analysis worker. `compute_freeze_result_rows()` returns event rows and per-cell event-index arrays. Its legacy temperature/correction arguments are not used by the current detection implementation; temperature matching occurs later in the import workflow.

icescopy_image_edit.summary: Shared image adjustments, rotated-crop geometry, and editing overlays.
icescopy_image_edit.details: The array adjustment path applies crop, exposure, then contrast. Display and measurement reuse these helpers so committed edits affect both. Transient crop previews and history are coordinated by the window. Original-image cell coordinates must be mapped through the crop transform for display and measurement; preserve the inverse mapping when translating pointer positions back to the source image.

ImageHistogramWidget.summary: Displays intensity histogram bins supplied by the image-edit workflow.

ImageRectOverlayItem.summary: Interactive rectangle for the uniform-exposure reference area.

ImageCropOverlayItem.summary: Interactive rotated crop outline with move, size, and angle handles.

icescopy_paths.summary: Find and atomically save per-user preference files.
icescopy_paths.details: `ICESCOPY_CONFIG_DIR` overrides the configuration directory for isolated runs. Otherwise Qt’s generic configuration location is used, with a home-directory fallback. Reads prefer a user file and fall back to bundled defaults. Writes serialize to a sibling temporary file, parse it, then replace the destination.

icescopy_save_access.summary: Recognize save-access failures and present retry/save-copy recovery choices.
icescopy_save_access.details: The helper reports relevant operating-system errors to the caller; the caller still owns serialization, retry logic, and destination selection. Platform recovery text is tested separately from window-title rendering.

icescopy_plot.summary: Render selected-cell grayscale curves, filtered curves, events, and the current frame.
icescopy_plot.details: The plot caches prepared series and limits displayed points while retaining peaks. The current-frame indicator is a widget overlay whose position is recomputed from the plot view mapping; it must remain aligned after resize, axis changes, or data refresh. These display optimizations do not replace stored measurements.

CurrentFrameLineOverlay.summary: Paints the current-frame line over the plot at a supplied widget coordinate.

GrayscalePlotWidget.summary: Displays selected cell measurements and detected/manual freeze events with frame navigation feedback.
GrayscalePlotWidget.details: When changing axis or layout behavior, exercise resize and frame changes with the native GUI as well as the coordinate-mapping tests.

icescopy_sample_catalog.summary: Qt model, delegates, and panel actions for editing sample metadata.
icescopy_sample_catalog.details: The tree model presents sample rows and field rows using the active schema. Edits validate field types and propagate fields marked “same for all” across the catalog. The panel mixin coordinates selection and persistent editors.

SampleCatalogNode.summary: Internal tree node for a sample or one of its metadata fields.

SampleCatalogTreeModel.summary: Maps sample IDs and schema fields into an editable two-column Qt model.
SampleCatalogTreeModel.details: Use `setData` through the model’s editing route to preserve validation, shared-field propagation, and history. A field can remain visible while irrelevant to a sample type.

SampleCatalogTreeDelegate.summary: Creates and commits editors appropriate to each metadata field type.

SampleCatalogTreeView.summary: Customizes the catalog tree’s branch drawing.

SampleCatalogPanelMixin.summary: Builds the catalog panel and coordinates sample creation, deletion, and editor refresh.

icescopy_sample_metadata.summary: Sample-field definitions, validation, serialization, and schema migration.
icescopy_sample_metadata.details: A schema is an ordered list of field definitions: key, label, type, export choice, shared-value choice, and relevant sample types. Fixed identity fields cannot be removed or have their keys renamed. Custom keys are validated; values are normalized to strings in catalog records. XML stores preference defaults, while session JSON stores the active schema.

SampleMetadataSchemaError.summary: Reports an invalid sample-field definition or schema.

icescopy_session.summary: Undo/redo commands and the frame-list model.
icescopy_session.details: Commands delegate restoration to the main window; they do not own a second independent session. Capture the smallest relevant before-state, apply the change, then use its matching push-history method. Keep the first-redo convention intact.

SessionSnapshotCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_session_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

SessionCellCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for cell geometry and associated captured state.
SessionCellCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_cell_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

SessionTimelineMarkersCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for timeline marker lists.
SessionTimelineMarkersCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_timeline_marker_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

SessionAnalysisMarkerCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for one analysis start/end marker.
SessionAnalysisMarkerCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_analysis_marker_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

SessionImageListCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for image ordering and linked session state.
SessionImageListCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_image_session_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

SessionLoadedImagesCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for loaded source/frame state.
SessionLoadedImagesCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_loaded_images_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

SessionDataCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for analysis result data.
SessionDataCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_data_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

SessionFreezeAnnotationCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for manual freeze annotations.
SessionFreezeAnnotationCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_freeze_annotation_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

SessionImageEditCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for image-edit settings and captured geometry/results.
SessionImageEditCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_image_edit_history_state`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

FrameNavigationCommand.summary: Undo/redo command for the selected frame.
FrameNavigationCommand.details: Delegates restoration to `IceScopy.restore_navigation_index`. The first `redo()` is deliberately skipped because the original edit has already happened before the command is pushed onto Qt’s undo stack.

ImageListModel.summary: Exposes frame names and tooltips to the image list without eagerly formatting every video frame.
ImageListModel.details: When attached to the main window, list rows can be mapped to a filtered set of source-frame indexes. Do not assume a row number always equals a source frame number.

icescopy_session_io.summary: Serialize session bundles and prepare validated restore state.
icescopy_session_io.details: A `.icescopy` file is a ZIP with `session.json` and any populated result tables as CSV members. Media are external references. Imported frame-to-cycle assignments for event review are stored separately from result tables in `freeze_review_cycle_metadata`. `load_session_bundle` reads the members; `build_restore_state` migrates the payload and constructs window-ready objects. Saving builds serialized content, verifies a temporary ZIP, then atomically replaces the destination. This prevents a failed serialization from truncating the previous session; it does not promise that missing external media can be recovered. `load_session_bundle()` returns `(payload, grayscale_table, freeze_table, freeze_count_table)`; each table is a `(headers, rows)` pair, empty when its member is absent. Loading the archive alone does not migrate or apply window state. `build_restore_state()` needs a main-window context to construct cell items. The session schema version is separate from the application release version.

_SessionFingerprintWriter.summary: Hashes serialized session content without retaining another copy of the text.
_SessionFingerprintWriter.details: Accepts text writes from JSON and CSV serializers, updates a SHA-256 digest with UTF-8 bytes, and returns the number of characters consumed. Used by session_content_fingerprint to detect document changes.

icescopy_stylesheet.summary: Shared Qt stylesheet strings for the application interface.
icescopy_stylesheet.details: This module defines presentation values rather than callable services. Window code chooses the appropriate styles and refreshes affected controls; keep state-changing behavior out of stylesheet definitions.

icescopy_temperature_import.summary: Parse temperature files and resolve timestamps and cooling cycles.
icescopy_temperature_import.details: Independent parsers cover standard CSV, UTK CSV, CSU `.dat`, TAMU Linkam `.xlsx`, and PKU Linksys32 `.iml`, with calibration and timestamp helpers. Result dataclasses carry parsed times and values; the freeze-count mixin joins them to cell events. Format-specific validation raises `TemperatureImportError`.

TemperatureImportError.summary: Reports a temperature-file or timestamp validation failure.

CSUISDatRow.summary: One parsed CSU row, including recorded timing and cumulative sample counts.

TAMULinkamTimeseries.summary: Parsed TAMU relative temperature times, temperatures, and an optional start timestamp.

Linksys32IMLImageRecord.summary: One Linksys32 image record with image number, timestamp, and temperature.

Linksys32IMLTimeseries.summary: Parsed Linksys32 temperature samples plus image-record associations.

StandardTemperatureTimeseries.summary: Parsed timestamp and temperature arrays for the standard CSV path.

ResolvedImageTimestamps.summary: Resolved image times, a successful-parse count, and names that could not be parsed.

icescopy_tool_options.summary: Reusable widgets for tool-option forms and information pages.
icescopy_tool_options.details: These helpers keep control sizes and layouts consistent across tool panels. Form construction belongs here; cell manipulation, image adjustments, and history remain in their corresponding controllers/window methods.

ToolOptionsFormPage.summary: Builds tool-option rows, numeric controls, lists, hints, and action buttons.

icescopy_validate.summary: Command-line checks for the installed package, dependencies, and required resources.
icescopy_validate.details: `icescopy-validate` calls `main()` and returns a nonzero exit status for missing dependencies, resources, package installation, or source/package version mismatch. It does not perform GUI interaction or validate scientific results.

icescopy_version.summary: The version value used by the application and Python package.
icescopy_version.details: `__version__` supplies Python package metadata and macOS bundle metadata. The Windows installer receives its version as a separate build parameter. Keep those values aligned deliberately when preparing a release.

icescopy_viewer.summary: Separate previous, current, and next frame panes with synchronized pan and zoom.
icescopy_viewer.details: The current pane retains the application's annotation scene. Neighboring panes own separate scenes for rendered frame images, read-only cells at each frame's stored or interpolated positions, and shared image-edit overlays. All panes use image-local coordinates and the same view transform and center. The Cells list also reports completed user selections so optional frame navigation and centering wait until the interaction ends. The window supplies rendered pixmaps and coordinates image edits; this module does not decode frames or own a second session state.

CellSelectionTreeWidget.summary: Reports completed Cells-list mouse and keyboard selections for optional frame navigation and centering.
CellSelectionTreeWidget.details: Captures selection state before a left-mouse gesture or keyboard action in the Cells list and reports the completed interaction afterward. A click on a top-level Cell row can reapply navigation even when the selection is unchanged; expanders, detail rows, blank space, and right-clicks do not. Up/Down navigation visits Cell rows and skips expanded details. The main window checks the active tool and interaction state before applying the independent Show freeze frame and Auto-center options. Image selections and programmatic selection refreshes do not pass through these event handlers.

LinkedGraphicsView.summary: Reports changes to image position and zoom so the other panes can follow them.
LinkedGraphicsView.details: `content_rect` stores the actual image bounds. The scrollable scene has extra space so each pane can center the same image point near an edge. Pass `content_rect`, rather than the expanded scene rectangle, when fitting the image. `cameraChanged` and `viewportResized` identify the view whose transform or size changed.

ReferenceGraphicsView.summary: Handles pan, zoom, and image-edit controls in a neighboring-frame pane.
ReferenceGraphicsView.details: Frame navigation and crop Apply/Cancel reach the main window. Cell selection and drawing remain in the current pane; Delete and Backspace in a neighboring pane do not delete a current-frame selection.

FramePanel.summary: Combines one frame's label, view, image, cell outlines, and image-edit overlays.
FramePanel.details: `refresh_cells()` reads the pane's own frame layout, copies geometry into read-only circle items, and applies that frame's crop transform without moving or changing stored cells. A missing pixmap clears the neighboring image and cells and hides its image-edit overlays. The compact label uses a slightly smaller native font, medium weight for the current pane, and a palette-colored bottom separator. It distinguishes unavailable edge frames from neighbors awaiting a completed video seek. `clear()` owns reference-scene cleanup; current-scene contents remain the main window's responsibility.

ComparisonViewer.summary: Arranges one, two, or three panes and keeps their image position and zoom synchronized.
ComparisonViewer.details: Two panes show previous/current frames; three show previous/current/next. `show_frames()` consumes already-rendered pixmaps without reading the frame source. `refresh_reference_cells()` updates neighboring-frame circles after layout, keyframe, or sample changes. `suspend_sync()` batches changes; the caller then chooses the view to synchronize from. Interaction modes follow the current view, while image-edit overlay state is maintained by the main window.

icescopy_video_preview.summary: Decode video previews outside the GUI thread.
icescopy_video_preview.details: The controller owns a Qt thread; the worker creates its own frame source from a preview payload. Decode results include frame identity and a source token so the window can reject stale results. Call the controller’s `close()` before replacing its source or disposing the window. Blocking shutdown is not a hard one-second guarantee: its queued close must wait for an in-progress decode.

VideoPreviewDecodeWorker.summary: Decodes requested preview frames and emits either an image or an error with source identity.

VideoPreviewDecodeController.summary: Owns the preview worker thread and forwards decode requests/results.
VideoPreviewDecodeController.details: `close(timeout_ms=1000)` disconnects new requests, invokes worker cleanup, quits the thread, and waits. The blocking worker invocation occurs before the timed wait.

icescopy_inptk_client.summary: Communicates with a separately installed INP toolkit process through queued requests.
icescopy_inptk_client.details: Starts the executable in serve mode and checks its advertised capabilities. Process I/O and JSON serialization run on a worker thread; callbacks return to the client thread. Request identifiers and connection generations keep replies associated with the operation that submitted them. Calculation code remains in the external toolkit.

ToolkitTransport.summary: Runs the toolkit process and exchanges newline-delimited JSON on a worker thread.
ToolkitTransport.details: Emits replies, process failures, and stderr diagnostics with a connection generation. Its compute slot also runs local jobs on the worker thread; these jobs must use snapshots and must not access Qt widgets.

InptkClient.summary: Queues toolkit requests and delivers results to the analysis window.
InptkClient.details: Owns the transport thread, connection test, pending requests, and local worker jobs. Supports asynchronous callbacks and blocking helpers used at save boundaries. Stopping invalidates pending work; shutdown also joins the worker thread.

icescopy_inptk_data.summary: Converts in-memory freeze counts and sample metadata into toolkit input records.
icescopy_inptk_data.details: Validates paired total/frozen columns, count values, and sample metadata. Uses each sample's corrected temperature when present, otherwise the shared temperature, and records rows skipped for missing temperature or cycle. Upload helpers select group members and assigned water blanks, omitting dilution and air/soil fields for blanks.

icescopy_inptk_export.summary: Arranges toolkit concentration and frozen-fraction tables for Icescopy CSV exports.
icescopy_inptk_export.details: Concentration exports use the returned cumulative tables without resampling, with temperature rows and concentration plus lower/upper bounds for each curve. Missing values become empty cells. Frozen-fraction export can follow the toolkit's selected observations. File writing refuses to overwrite an existing path.

icescopy_inptk_panel.summary: Provides the INP analysis window, its preferences widget, and analysis history.
icescopy_inptk_panel.details: Coordinates sample groups, blank selection, temperature limits, count previews, toolkit requests, plots, and exports. Combined calculations and direct individual concentrations are requested from the external toolkit. The window keeps separate undo/redo history and saves analysis choices and results with the Icescopy session.

InpSettingsCommand.summary: Restores before/after analysis choices through the panel's undo stack.
InpSettingsCommand.details: The first redo does nothing because the edit has already been applied. Later undo and redo calls restore their respective choice snapshots.

RangeLimitDelegate.summary: Displays available endpoints as placeholders in temperature-limit cells.
RangeLimitDelegate.details: Uses the cell's user-role text when no explicit limit is set. The placeholder does not become an analysis cutoff when the editor opens.

InptkPreferencesWidget.summary: Lets users choose and test a separately installed toolkit executable.
InptkPreferencesWidget.details: Keeps the path in a line edit and uses InptkClient to test the connection. Displays the reported toolkit version and stops the test process after a successful connection.

InptkPanel.summary: Manages the analysis window and its current inputs, choices, and results.
InptkPanel.details: Uses a regular Qt window with application modality to block edits to the source session while analysis is open. Requests count and concentration tables from the toolkit, retains direct individual comparisons, and draws the selected groups. Native result data is captured at save/export boundaries; session restoration retains choices, plot data, and saved results.

icescopy_inptk_plot.summary: Supplies axes, legends, and draggable temperature controls for INP plots.
icescopy_inptk_plot.details: Keeps plot geometry and mouse handling separate from the analysis window. Temperature tags map between screen positions and the plot axis and emit edits for the panel to apply. Axis limits depend on the displayed quantity and finite values; these helpers do not calculate concentrations.

_FixedLegend.summary: Prevents the plot legend from being moved by dragging.
_FixedLegend.details: Overrides the inherited drag handler so the legend stays at its assigned position.

PlotLegend.summary: Places a compact, scrollable legend at the top right of the plot viewport.
PlotLegend.details: Wraps legend text, limits its displayed size, and schedules placement updates after resizing or view changes. Hides the view when there are no entries.

TemperatureTags.summary: Draws and drags the active sample's temperature tags below the plot.
TemperatureTags.details: Reserves a fixed-height lane, maps tags to the current plot coordinates, and honors locked boundaries. Movement signals identify the sample, boundary, temperature, and whether the drag has finished; the panel applies the edit.

ConcentrationAxis.summary: Formats concentration ticks on a logarithmic plot axis.
ConcentrationAxis.details: Chooses decade spacing from the visible span and available height, with intermediate ticks where space permits. Adjusts tick labels without changing plotted concentrations.

TemperatureRangeItem.summary: Allows temperature-boundary dragging while leaving the region interior available for plot navigation.
TemperatureRangeItem.details: Ignores mouse gestures on the region interior. Its boundary lines retain their own drag handling.

icescopy_inptk_state.summary: Stores analysis choices and translates them into toolkit command arguments.
icescopy_inptk_state.details: Defines defaults, reconciles choices with the sample catalogue, validates group membership, and assigns selected water blanks. Builds commands for calculation and range suggestions. Direct individual comparisons use separate Average choices without combination limits. An absent manual boundary is left for the toolkit to resolve.

icescopy_droplet_detection.summary: Trains and runs a random-forest detector from marked droplet circles.
icescopy_droplet_detection.details: Builds image features and training labels from complete circle annotations, augments images and circles together, and trains with scikit-learn. The detector reads validated numeric trees from JSON and predicts new circles with NumPy and OpenCV. This model format is separate from the neural detector's ONNX bundles.

CancelledError.summary: Signals that droplet training or detection was cancelled.
CancelledError.details: Raised when a supplied cancellation callback requests that work stop.

Circle.summary: Stores a circle center and radius for random-forest detection and training.
Circle.details: An immutable record with finite coordinates and a positive radius, expressed in image pixels.

RandomForestDetector.summary: Evaluates validated decision trees and converts predicted regions into circles.
RandomForestDetector.details: Averages tree probabilities over image features, then finds connected regions above the model threshold. Accepts up to two guidance circles to set image scale, or uses the model's default radius. Excludes detections that duplicate guidance or protected circles.

icescopy_droplet_tools.summary: Connects neural droplet detection to the toolbar, frame state, and cell history.
icescopy_droplet_tools.details: Copies original frame pixels and circle geometry before starting a worker. When detection finishes, checks that the source and cell state still match the snapshot, filters proposed circles, and inserts the accepted cells as one undoable edit.

DetectionSnapshot.summary: Holds the frame pixels, guidance circles, and geometry captured for one detection run.
DetectionSnapshot.details: Keeps a state token, protected circles, crop transform, and output size alongside the image so the result can be checked before insertion.

DetectionWorker.summary: Runs neural detection on a captured frame in a Qt worker thread.
DetectionWorker.details: Loads the detector from its model configuration, passes the interruption check into prediction, and emits completion, cancellation, or failure signals.

DropletDetectionTools.summary: Owns the detection action, model configuration, worker, and result insertion.
DropletDetectionTools.details: Uses selected circles as guidance and existing circles as protected regions. Snapshot validation rejects results after relevant session changes. Accepted circles must fit the image and crop and are added together through the main window's cell history.

icescopy_droplet_training_io.summary: Reads annotated frames and linked images from Icescopy sessions for detector training.
icescopy_droplet_training_io.details: Reads bounded session JSON from the session archive and exposes saved current-frame and keyframe annotations. Resolves linked media relative to the session or a supplied relink folder, validates requested frames, and loads raw RGB pixels with their circles. Does not restore result CSV tables or modify the saved session.

TrainingSessionError.summary: Reports invalid training-session contents or unavailable linked media.
TrainingSessionError.details: Used when a session, frame selection, or media path cannot provide the annotated training data.

TrainingFrame.summary: Identifies one saved annotated frame and its circles.
TrainingFrame.details: Records the frame index and whether the annotations came from the saved current frame. The label property supplies a frame-selection label.

TrainingSession.summary: Holds parsed session metadata, available annotated frames, and an optional relink folder.
TrainingSession.details: Looks up only frames with saved annotations. Relinking returns a new record with the replacement folder and leaves the original session file unchanged.

icescopy_neural_detection.summary: Loads ONNX droplet models and runs CPU inference with optional guidance circles.
icescopy_neural_detection.details: Validates the model metadata and network files before loading them with OpenCV. Averages descriptors from the supplied guidance circles, or uses the model reference when none are given. Predicts circles over overlapping image tiles and removes duplicates and protected objects.

Circle.summary: Stores a circle center and radius for neural detection.
Circle.details: An immutable record that converts its coordinates and radius to finite floats and requires a positive radius, in image pixels.

ModelConfig.summary: Holds validated model identity, network paths, and inference settings.
ModelConfig.details: Includes the default guidance descriptor and radius. For an unpacked model bundle, retains the temporary directory until the configuration is released.

NeuralDetector.summary: Uses reference and detector networks to predict new droplet circles.
NeuralDetector.details: Runs OpenCV DNN inference on the CPU with raw RGB uint8 images. Accepts any number of guidance circles and returns circle/score records after duplicate suppression. Cancellation returns an empty result rather than partial detections.

icescopy_temperature_refresh.summary: Retains temperature-import inputs so freeze counts can be rebuilt after session edits.
icescopy_temperature_refresh.details: Encodes parsed input records, arrays, and timestamps into session-compatible values. A refresh context records the importer, options, and frame identity. Rebuilding checks that the same frames remain in the same order, then calls the matching standard, .dat, TAMU, or PKU count builder.

SampleCatalogTreeWidget.summary: The sample catalog now uses a model/view implementation. Editing and data access are split between the model, delegate, view, and panel mixin.
